action.name: Final H1-H5 evidence complete; single Trading V1.1 policy decision gate
action.objective: Preserve the validated reduced-support research evidence and await one consolidated Trading V1.1 policy decision before any further empirical execution or PnL access.
prerequisites: 110/110 native H5 reporting unit hashes PASS
held-out access event and 524 R4 engineering checkpoints preserved
allowed_scope: read-only inspection of frozen aggregation-level researcher evidence
closing publication of the completed authorized research action and its single explicitly unapproved policy decision inventory
control-framework maintenance explicitly requested by the researcher
forbidden_scope: R4-2025 execution repair approximation or imputation
recomputation of valid completed scientific checkpoints
new model metric support scale threshold comparator Search Budget or winner rule
Trading V1.1 policy selection without researcher decision
any trading PnL computation or inspection
action.publication_scope: Closing transaction only: validated evidence document/manifest, completion record, current control state, run log, validators and the unapproved consolidated policy inventory. These permissions do not authorize new scientific computation or trading.
action.completion_condition: Researcher resolves the complete consolidated Trading V1.1 policy inventory in one decision and a separately authorized successor action is frozen and published; otherwise remain stopped.
mandatory_stop_conditions: attempted trading or A6/G5 execution without separate authority
attempt to infer an H4 final-held-out disposition from computational incompleteness
